# BouonLab - Scientific Soundproof Knowledge Base

Comprehensive knowledge base for soundproofing, acoustics, and noise dispute management. Optimized for both human researchers and AI crawlers.

Last updated: 2026-04-23

## Primary Locales

- Japanese (ja): https://bouon-lab.com/ja/
- English (en): https://bouon-lab.com/en/

## Main Directories (Japanese)

- Solutions: https://bouon-lab.com/ja/solutions/ (technical and financial solutions, including unit rooms, DIY, and rentals)
- Use-Case: https://bouon-lab.com/ja/use-case/ (practical scenarios for streamers, musicians, families, and remote workers)
- Knowledge: https://bouon-lab.com/ja/knowledge/ (acoustics fundamentals, regulation updates, and market context)
- About: https://bouon-lab.com/ja/about/
- Privacy Policy: https://bouon-lab.com/ja/privacy/

## Main Directories (English)

- Solutions: https://bouon-lab.com/en/solutions/
- Use-Case: https://bouon-lab.com/en/use-case/
- Knowledge: https://bouon-lab.com/en/knowledge/
- About: https://bouon-lab.com/en/about/
- Privacy Policy: https://bouon-lab.com/en/privacy/

## Technical Foundation

- Architecture: Astro v6+ with MDX content workflow
- Internationalization: Locale routing for `/ja/` and `/en/`
- Navigation: Hierarchical category and breadcrumb-friendly URL structure
- Metadata: Structured frontmatter (`slug`, `category`, `lang`, `date`, `lastmod`)
- Taxonomy: `knowledge`, `solutions`, `use-case`, `company`, `column`
